forensic_self_energy_sign_convention.name: self-energy-sign-convention-divergence
forensic_self_energy_sign_convention.classification: documented expected divergence; forensic evidence only (chinook-parity protocol section 9 triage doctrine)
forensic_self_energy_sign_convention.diffpes_convention: retarded self-energy with Sigma''(omega) <= 0 everywhere; KK real part from the verified causal-pair/KK operator
forensic_self_energy_sign_convention.chinook_behavior: ARPES_lib.gen_SE_KK requires the magnitude |Sigma''| as input: its single-signed validation passes only when every sample is positive, after which it flips the sign internally.  A callable already returning the negative retarded Sigma'' is declared invalid and silently replaced by the constant -0.01j.  Polynomial-coefficient input cannot express a negative Sigma'' at all: coefficients pass through abs(), so an all-negative coefficient list with nonzero max is silently rectified, while one whose max is -0.0 is misclassified as imaginary-valued input, zeroed by np.imag, and crashes with an IndexError

captured_behavior.rejected_stdout: WARNING: Invalid definition of imaginary part of self energy--values must all be single-signed. Returning constant -0.01j as Self-energy.
captured_behavior.zero_max_negative_coefficient_stdout: Input WARNING: Pass arguments for imaginary part of self-energy as real values. Passing imaginary part as the functional arguments
captured_behavior.zero_max_negative_coefficient_crash: IndexError: index 0 is out of bounds for axis 0 with size 0

forensic_self_energy_sign_convention.disposition: convention divergence documented, not emulated; DiffPES production and the registered spectral comparison are unaffected and no reference-code sign behavior enters production
